summary.zh-CN: DeskBox 2026101301 x64 直发版：种树改为窄矩形冒泡进度条，百分比显示在条内；系统监控磁盘卡片支持双击打开，任务格子布局更紧凑。主程序采用 Native AOT，本次暂无 ARM64 安装包。
summary.en-US: DeskBox 2026101301 adds a slimmer bubbling tree progress bar with its percentage inside, double-click disk cards in System Monitor, and a more compact task widget. This x64 release uses Native AOT; ARM64 is not available yet.
